test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q and R can complete a piece of work in 9, 12 and 18 days, respectively. Working together, how much work can they complete in one day?
solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

P, Q, and R can complete a work in 9, 12, and 18 days, respectively. 

Rate of P = 1/9 (work/day)

Rate of Q = 1/12 (work/day)

Rate of R = 1/18 (work/day)

Combined rate = Rate of P + Rate of Q + Rate of R

= 1/9 + 1/12 + 1/18 = (4 + 3 + 2)/36 = 9/36 = 1/4 (work/day)

**∴ when P, Q, and R work together, they can complete 1/4 of the work in one day.**
